project.name: parallel_fullstack
project.description: 全栈开发：需求→设计→视觉→后端+前端并行→集成测试

agents.name: Requirements Analyst
agents.role_goal: 分析用户需求，产出结构化需求文档。
acceptance_criteria: Must contain at least 2 user stories

agents.name: Product Designer
agents.role_goal: 基于需求定义产品功能清单和API契约。

agents.name: Visual Designer
agents.role_goal: 定义视觉风格、色彩方案和UI组件规范。

agents.name: Backend Developer
agents.role_goal: 根据产品规格和视觉简报生成FastAPI后端代码。

agents.name: Frontend Developer
agents.role_goal: 根据视觉简报和API契约生成HTML/CSS/JS前端页面。
acceptance_criteria: Must link to backend API endpoints

agents.name: Integration Tester
agents.role_goal: 验证前后端集成：API契约一致性、视觉还原度、端到端功能。
acceptance_criteria: Must output PASS or FAIL verdict
